Bug_Title: ASE: Expression in assertion may produce a side effect (ASE_ASSERTION_WITH_SIDE_EFFECT)
Bug_Details:
Expressions used in assertions must not produce side effects. See SEI CERT Rule EXP06
for more information.
 SEI CERT Rule EXP06
Bug_Explanation: The assert statement in the showBug method calls incrementCounter(), which increments the counter variable. This produces a side effect, which is not allowed in an assert statement.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUNIT test case triggered the bug by calling the showBug method with the input value of 1. The assert statement in the showBug method calls incrementCounter(), which increments the counter variable, causing a side effect in the assert statement.
